name: Brimstone whelp
description: a brimstone whelp, a young demon of the Cracked Road the size of a dog, on four stubby clawed legs: cracked black basalt hide with thin orange glowing seams, two stubby charred horns, a big jaw glowing like a furnace, a short rock tail

poses.stand: standing on four stubby legs side-on, jaw glowing, tail up
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands panting, its jaw glowing, tail wagging

move.action: scuttles fast forward on its stubby legs, jaw glowing, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
